summary: InflaRx N.V., a Nasdaq-listed German foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing peer-reviewed publication of first-in-human Phase 1 data for izicopan (formerly INF904), an oral small molecule C5aR1 inhibitor. The randomized, placebo-controlled SAD/MAD study enrolled 86 healthy participants; dosing ranged 3-240 mg single and 30 mg QD/BID to 90 mg BID for 14 days, with favorable tolerability and dose-dependent exposure. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or regulatory clock is disclosed. This is routine clinical/regulatory disclosure, not a special situation; watch pipeline/Phase 2 progression, not deal arbitrage.
